findings: terminal-review repair (AR-F01, high): reader.py unbounded manifest read and recovery.py read_bytes, plus symlink-following stream access, are repaired at design level by architecture.md section 7.1 and detailed-design.md section 8.5: os.lstat confinement and O_NOFOLLOW pre-I/O checks, bounded manifest/stream/line/diagnostic reads, TOCTOU lstat/fstat device-inode comparison, and caller-authoritative limits with the manifest limits echo treated as untrusted recorded data. Bound to ARGUS2-ADV-01 and ARGUS2-ADV-02.

terminal-review repair (AR-F02, high): reader.py read_run/export_json exposing the manifest's recorded complete status for corrupt evidence is repaired by detailed-design.md section 11.1: separate recordedEvidenceStatus/reasons and assessedEvidenceStatus/reasons, with assessed incompleteness (including ARGUS2-REASON-CORRUPT-MANIFEST/EVENT) primary and verify exit code 0 requiring assessed complete. Bound to ARGUS2-ADV-03.

terminal-review repair (AR-F03, high): recovery.py validate_event_record and reader manifest-shape handling are repaired by detailed-design.md sections 12.1 and 16.1: complete closed nested-schema validation, required run/event/producer identity, run-ID consistency, per-run eventId uniqueness, strictly increasing ingestionOrdinal from 1, finite values, malformed-container and I/O handling, and a no-uncaught-TypeError/ValueError rule with stable categorized diagnostics. Bound to ARGUS2-ADV-04 and ARGUS2-ADV-05.

terminal-review repair (AR-F04, high): writer.py finalize/abort publishing through _publish without the max_manifest_bytes check is repaired by detailed-design.md section 4.4: one publication chokepoint measures the actual canonical serialized bytes (including artifact index, obligations and finalize/abort metadata) before the atomic replace; an exceeded bound or I/O failure preserves the prior manifest bytes and returns a stable diagnostic without claiming closed/complete persistence. Bound to ARGUS2-ADV-06.

terminal-review repair (AR-F05, high): api.py _validate_obligations shallow-copy aliasing of nested detail and writer.py record_artifact returned-view aliasing are repaired by detailed-design.md sections 14.1 and 12.2: deep canonical snapshots of admitted obligations/envelope/digests/clocks/extensions, internally owned artifact size/hash identity, and immutable/defensive returned views, so post-admission caller mutation cannot lower an obligation or rewrite an indexed file hash. Bound to ARGUS2-ADV-07.
